scope: Known public MIT Corona Admin source from the initial real-project corpus, unmodified byte-identical HTML files. This is a new authored 16-criterion pressure task on known source, not a new repository, held-out project, client delivery, runtime test or unseen generalization sample.
referenceMethod: Codex AI source inspection fixed before this new task provider call. Four actual manual requirements plus twelve literal source coverage groups are derived by production intake. Every source-only attribute/text obligation is explicit; login, money movement, persistence and mobile rendering require unavailable execution evidence. Source provenance and complete MIT license: scripts/real-project-assessment-provenance-2026-11-05.json origins[real-corona-admin] and public/benchmarks/real-projects-2026-11-05/source-provenance/corona-admin-LICENSE.txt. No holdout files read.

projects.title: Known-source Corona Admin: sixteen distinct acceptance checks
projects.summary:
Dashboard source copy must pair Transfer to Paypal with $236.
Dashboard source copy must spell the second transfer label Transfer to Stripe.
Henry Klein must have Credit card and Approved in his source table row.
Dashboard source text must not contain Cash on delivered.
Login source labels must include Username or email * and Password *.
Register source email input must have type="email".
Register source Terms & Conditions link href must be terms.html.
404 source Back to home link href must be ../../index.html.
Login must authenticate correct credentials and reject incorrect passwords.
Paypal transfer must actually pay $236 and confirm provider status.
New accounts must persist and remain queryable after a server restart.
At 375px the dashboard table must remain readable without page overflow.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 1
criteria.source: In the delivered dashboard HTML the Order Status table must contain the literal headings Payment Mode and Payment Status.

reference.rationale: The complete index.html table th elements contain both exact column labels; this requirement is source text only and says nothing about actual payments.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 2
criteria.source: In the delivered login HTML the input immediately under Password * must use type="password" rather than type="text".

reference.rationale: The complete login.html Password * form-group contains input type="text". The requirement explicitly addresses a delivered HTML attribute, not observed password masking or authentication.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 3
criteria.source: In the delivered register HTML the primary submit button text must read Create account rather than Login.

reference.rationale: The register.html form submit button still has text Login. The proposed required literal Create account is absent from that button; no submission behavior is asserted.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 4
criteria.source: The delivered 404 HTML document title must be Not found - Corona Admin rather than the generic Corona Admin.

reference.rationale: error-404.html title is exactly Corona Admin. This literal metadata mismatch is provable without testing server status codes or rendering.

criteria.title: Original requirement 1
criteria.source: Dashboard source copy must pair Transfer to Paypal with $236.

reference.rationale: The first Transaction History card in index.html pairs Transfer to Paypal and $236. This is static template copy, not a provider transaction.

criteria.title: Original requirement 2
criteria.source: Dashboard source copy must spell the second transfer label Transfer to Stripe.

reference.rationale: The second Transaction History card says Tranfer to Stripe with a missing s. The exact requested spelling is not present; it is not a demand for real Stripe execution.

criteria.title: Original requirement 3
criteria.source: Henry Klein must have Credit card and Approved in his source table row.

reference.rationale: Within the Order Status tbody row containing Henry Klein, Payment Mode is Credit card and Payment Status is Approved. These are fictional public sample row values.

criteria.title: Original requirement 4
criteria.source: Dashboard source text must not contain Cash on delivered.

reference.rationale: The Order Status row for Estella Bryan contains the prohibited literal Cash on delivered. The requirement is a negative static text constraint.

criteria.title: Original requirement 5
criteria.source: Login source labels must include Username or email * and Password *.

reference.rationale: login.html contains both exact label texts, irrespective of authentication behavior.

criteria.title: Original requirement 6
criteria.source: Register source email input must have type="email".

reference.rationale: register.html Email form-group contains input type="email". This only establishes that static attribute, not validation execution.

criteria.title: Original requirement 7
criteria.source: Register source Terms & Conditions link href must be terms.html.

reference.rationale: register.html terms paragraph has an anchor href="#" rather than the required terms.html. No external terms contents or legal conclusion is inferred.

criteria.title: Original requirement 8
criteria.source: 404 source Back to home link href must be ../../index.html.

reference.rationale: error-404.html Back to home anchor has this exact relative href. The requirement is literal source metadata, not proof of browser navigation or HTTP status.

criteria.title: Original requirement 9
criteria.source: Login must authenticate correct credentials and reject incorrect passwords.

reference.rationale: Only a static template subset is supplied; no authentication server, session or valid/invalid login execution is available.

criteria.title: Original requirement 10
criteria.source: Paypal transfer must actually pay $236 and confirm provider status.

reference.rationale: Source sample labels and amounts are not payment execution. No provider response or actual funds evidence supplied and no financial action is attempted.

criteria.title: Original requirement 11
criteria.source: New accounts must persist and remain queryable after a server restart.

reference.rationale: No account persistence service, server restart or independent account readback supplied.

criteria.title: Original requirement 12
criteria.source: At 375px the dashboard table must remain readable without page overflow.

reference.rationale: CSS, browser rendering and mobile measurements are not supplied. HTML table classes do not establish measured viewport behavior.
